nodes.title: 3D Game Engineering
nodes.summary: Physics, NPC pathfinding, and gameplay systems across UE5, Unity, and Roblox Studio from 2019 to 2024.
nodes.html:
I built 3D gameplay systems from 2019 to 2024, working with physics, NPC pathfinding, and player interactions in Unreal Engine 5, Unity, and Roblox Studio. This work taught me to connect code, visuals, input, and feedback into something a player can learn by doing.

Connected notes: [[ap-capstone-driving-sim]], [[vt-cs-systems]], [[visual-storytelling]].

nodes.title: Cognitive & Routine Systems
nodes.summary: Neuroscience-informed habit architecture, attention routines, and game theory.
impact: Use iOS Shortcuts and Obsidian to reduce friction in everyday routines.
nodes.html:
I draw on neuroscience research about sleep and attention to design routines with clearer cues and less friction. I use iOS Shortcuts and Obsidian to make the next action easier. Hold’em ranges, expected value, and chess give me ways to practice decision-making under uncertainty.

Connected notes: [[lockin]], [[ap-capstone-driving-sim]], [[beyond-code]].

nodes.html:
I use the DDJ-SB3 with Serato to practice phrasing, transitions, and pacing across house and techno sets.

Connected notes: [[visual-storytelling]].

nodes.title: OpenDSA @ Virginia Tech
nodes.summary: Ruby on Rails, PostgreSQL staging tables, scheduled cron jobs, and client-side IndexedDB caching for interactive CS learning analytics.
impact: Built instructor analytics around PostgreSQL staging tables and scheduled jobs.
Implemented client-side caching with IndexedDB through localForage.
nodes.html: Building high-throughput instructor analytics and client-side caching via localForage at Virginia Tech. Connects directly to my focus on [[autoviz-engine]] and [[intelent-ai]].

nodes.title: Cinema & Optics
nodes.summary: Image-making with a Sony ZV-E10, Viltrox 9mm lens, black mist diffusion, and DaVinci Resolve.
impact: Shot and color-graded visual essays and event reels.
nodes.html:
I shoot on a Sony ZV-E10 with a Viltrox 9mm lens and use black mist diffusion to soften highlights. In DaVinci Resolve I refine color, timing, and the continuity between shots.

nodes.title: VT CS & Systems Stack

nodes.html:
My Virginia Tech computer science stack spans C and C++, Java, RISC-V and x86-64 assembly, PostgreSQL, and Docker. It connects low-level systems work with the tools I use to build and run applications.
